capabilities: Show a month calendar of note creation and modification dates
Render a GitHub-style activity heatmap over a 90, 180 or 365 day window
List a selected day's created and modified notes
Track writing streaks with milestone badges and a lifetime best
Filter activity by excluded folders or required tags
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later (older versions get 0.3.4); localization ships with English only and invites community-contributed locales. The README details exactly which vault data the plugin reads (paths, frontmatter, tags, file times) and states it makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian gives no at-a-glance view of when notes across the vault were created or last changed, so daily writing cadence is invisible.

relations.evidence: The calendar's look follows Liam Cain's Calendar plugin. Vault Pulse uses none of its code.
exposes the calendar dot, flame and trophy colors as editable variables when the Style Settings plugin is installed

summary: Sidebar pane showing a month calendar and a GitHub-style heatmap of note creation and modification activity over up to 365 days, with streak tracking.
